page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 62.0 GB of system memory. For acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU from the Turing family, which provides 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks generally achieve average results. The primary strength of this instance lies in its GPU-driven capabilities. In LLM inference benchmarks, prompt processing speeds for both small and medium models rank in the top 10%, while text generation for the medium model is strong, placing in the top 25%.

Given the hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require massive CPU compute or high-speed local storage. The combination of an NVIDIA T4 GPU and 16 vCPUs makes it suitable for machine learning inference, small-to-medium language model serving, and GPU-accelerated rendering. It is less suited for CPU-heavy single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high local disk I/O.
